sections.heading: Lock Locations
sections.text: Grate doors at the prison cells no. 1, 2 and 4 on the third floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building at Streets of Tarkov. Only accessible via the western staircase.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Dead Scav (both in Cell 1)
- Loose loot (Valuables, Provisions, Stimulants, Electronics, , Other items)
